prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Changes:
0: [adoption, redesign] Interactive Pet Preview & Redesign: Redesign the pet pick screen into a stage layout with dynamic animated pet previews so users test interactions before choosing. (why: Adoption step has low conversion (60.9%) and long mean time (1017s), plus 3 support emails reported custom pet visual issues.)
1: [sign_in, reorder] Deferred Sign-in After Adoption: Move sign-in after the adoption certificate so users choose and customize their pet before creating an account. (why: Sign-in drops 27.1% of users upfront and 8 support emails reported lost or reset pets after signing in.)
2: [home, new_screen] Desktop Controls Walkthrough Screen: Add a dedicated interactive guide screen before desktop entry that details how to summon, move, and hide the desktop pet. (why: Waiting median time is 201s and 3 support emails reported confusion on how to control or hide pets post-setup.)
3: [choose_path, new_flow] Guided Path Quiz Flow: Introduce a interactive quick-quiz screen before path selection to help users choose between standard and custom pets. (why: Path selection takes a mean time of 514s and loses 23.8% of initial users.)
4: [adoption, hint] Custom Photo Quality Guidance: Add photo lighting and angle guidance hints on the upload screen to improve pet rendering quality. (why: 3 support emails reported custom pet generation failures or unexpected rendering outcomes.)
5: [home, wait_info] Real-time Waiting Progress & Taskbar Tips: Display explicit rendering progress and system tray tips on the waiting screen while pet assets render. (why: Waiting step mean time is 2336s and 3 users reported pet not appearing on desktop.)
6: [finish, redesign] Interactive Desktop Onboarding Stage: Redesign home_intro into a stage layout with short video demos and interactive test buttons for pet shortcuts. (why: Finish conversion drops to 64.8% with long completion times, and users struggle with post-onboarding controls.)
